about_the_game:
"LOVE, DEATH and STRAWBERRY" is a story addition for the "Tiny Bunny" horror visual novel in the form of a manga. It includes the events that happen between episodes 3 and 4 that are not present in the game. If features characters from the game's main cast: Katya, Anton, Polina. Come find out what happened to Katya Smirnova, and maybe see her from a different angle. Other beloved characters will also be present in the story. The manga is split into 3 parts: Part 1 is a canon story that explains the events happening between episodes 3 and 4, and it focuses on developing some of the characters that don't have as much screen time in the original game. It was designed and written by the game's narrative designer, Evgeni Sokarev, and the game's director and artist, Saikono. Part 2 contains concept art of the manga's characters. Part 3 is a collection of short stories in the game's universe by the manga's artist, Yulia Eydina. Scenario – Saikono, Evgeni Sokarev Art – Yulia Eydina
Cover art – Saikono"
